milestones.title: ChatGPT launches
milestones.note: The public chatbot built on GPT-3.5 that brought large language models to the mainstream.
milestones.significance: The moment large language models reached the general public. Everything in this timeline after November 2022 happens in a market ChatGPT created.

provenance.reason: Date confirmed in an archived primary source. A milestone records a dated event, so it carries no specifications.

milestones.title: Bard launches
milestones.note: Google's ChatGPT rival chatbot that brought the company into the consumer AI race.
milestones.significance: Google's first consumer answer to ChatGPT, and the start of the assistant race between the two largest labs.
